parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  model: "z-ai/glm-5",
  temperature: 0.6,
  messages: [
    {
      role: "system",
      content: "You write punchy, high-retention UK short-form vertical video scripts for Dignitate (dementia-care support for carers). Use UK English. Direct, warm, confident. Output STRICT JSON only."
    },
    {
      role: "user",
      content:
        "TOPIC LOCK (must stay exact): " + ($json.args || "signs of caregiver burnout") +
        "\n\nSELECTED ARTICLE FACT ANCHOR (highest priority):\n" +
        JSON.stringify({
          summary: $json.selectedTrendSummary || '',
          source_name: $json.selectedTrendSourceName || '',
          source_url: $json.selectedTrendSourceUrl || '',
          published_at: $json.selectedTrendPublishedAt || ''
        }, null, 2) +
        "\n\nRESEARCH SUMMARY:\n" + ($json.researchSummary || "No research summary available.") +
        "\n\nRESEARCH FACTS (ONLY source for numbers/claims):\n" + JSON.stringify($json.researchFacts || [], null, 2) +
        "\n\nPRACTICAL ACTIONS (use for step language):\n" + JSON.stringify($json.researchActions || [], null, 2) +
        "\n\nVIDEO MODE: " + ($json.videoMode || "kling_multiclip") +
        "\n\n" + ((String($json.videoMode || "").toLowerCase() === "talking_head")
          ? "TASK: Write ONE vertical short as a TALKING-HEAD presenter clip: exactly 1 scene (18 seconds)."
          : "TASK: Write ONE vertical short as MULTI-SHOT b-roll: exactly 2 scenes (12 seconds each).") +
        "\n\nSCRIPT RULES:" +
        "\n- Hook fast. First line is a question or bold statement." +
        "\n- Speak directly to one person (you/your)." +
        "\n- Plain language only, no academic tone." +
        "\n- Use at most ONE statistic, and only if present in RESEARCH FACTS." +
        "\n- Never include recommendation/search/debug lines (recommendation, search results, topic lock, schema, could not find)." +
        "\n- Never use these labels: Why this matters now, What changed, Evidence update, Key takeaway, Next step, Conclusion." +
        "\n- No bullets, no headings, no stage directions, no citations, no URLs." +
        "\n- Keep wording aligned to selected article anchor and do not switch topic." +
        "\n\nTIMING (strict):\n" + ((String($json.videoMode || "").toLowerCase() === "talking_head")
          ? "- Narration: 38-50 words. Include hook + 1-2 key points + 1 practical step + CTA: Follow Dignitate for support."
          : "- Scene 1 narration: 22-30 words, hook + one concrete fact + one practical step.\n- Scene 2 narration: 22-30 words, what it means + one action + CTA: Follow Dignitate for support.") +
        "\n\nVISUAL PROMPT RULES:" +
        "\n- Vertical 9:16 documentary/editorial photorealism." +
        "\n- Talking head: podcast-style presenter with visible microphone, chest-up." +
        "\n- Multi-shot: different angle and different environment per scene." +
        "\n- B-roll only: no visible lip movement or speaking-to-camera direction." +
        "\n- Use simple uncluttered framing and describe only the real scene and subjects." +
        "\n- No collage/grid/split-screen/text/logos/watermarks." +
        "\n\nOUTPUT JSON ONLY (exact shape):\n" +
        ((($json.videoMode || "").toLowerCase() === "talking_head")
          ? "{\"title\":\"...\",\"scenes\":[{\"type\":\"hook\",\"narration\":\"...\",\"visualPrompt\":\"...\",\"duration\":18}],\"hashtags\":[\"#DementiaCare\",\"#CarerSupport\",\"#UKHealth\",\"#Dignitate\"],\"caption\":\"...\"}"
          : "{\"title\":\"...\",\"scenes\":[{\"type\":\"hook\",\"narration\":\"...\",\"visualPrompt\":\"...\",\"duration\":12},{\"type\":\"cta\",\"narration\":\"...\",\"visualPrompt\":\"...\",\"duration\":12}],\"hashtags\":[\"#DementiaCare\",\"#CarerSupport\",\"#UKHealth\",\"#Dignitate\"],\"caption\":\"...\"}")
    }
  ]
}) }}

parameters.text:
Everything is running smoothly.
Build: v3-stable-2026-02-11-lock-throttle-fix

I can research a topic, create carousel or video drafts, pull trends, and post approved drafts.

Tell me what you want to create, for example: "Create a carousel about caregiver burnout in South Asian families."

I can work like a normal chat assistant.

Try prompts like:
- Create a carousel about dementia-friendly home routines
- Make a short video about signs of caregiver burnout
- What are the latest UK dementia-care trends?
- This looks good, post it
- Regenerate this with a more hopeful tone

Meeting reels:
- /meeting <recording_url>
- Passcode: <if needed>
- Reels: 4 (default)
- Length: 25-40s

Creator profile for realistic videos:
- /setface <public_image_url>
- /setvoiceid <elevenlabs_voice_id>
- /creator
- /commands

Auto mode is currently disabled.

Give me your topic and preferred format, and I will handle the workflow.
={{ $json.trendMessage || "Trending topic unavailable." }}

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  model: "perplexity/sonar-pro",
  messages: [
    {
      role: "system",
      content: "You are a UK dementia-care research analyst for Dignitate. Return strict JSON only. Keep one exact topic and avoid speculation."
    },
    {
      role: "user",
      content:
        "TOPIC LOCK (must stay exact): " + ($json.args || "signs of caregiver burnout") +
        "\n\nSELECTED ARTICLE CONTEXT (PRIMARY ANCHOR):\n" +
        JSON.stringify({
          summary: $json.selectedTrendSummary || '',
          category: $json.selectedTrendCategory || '',
          region: $json.selectedTrendRegion || '',
          source_url: $json.selectedTrendSourceUrl || '',
          source_name: $json.selectedTrendSourceName || '',
          published_at: $json.selectedTrendPublishedAt || ''
        }, null, 2) +
        "\n\nResearch this exact topic for a UK dementia-care short video." +
        "\n- Use selected article context first; web research only supplements." +
        "\n- Do not switch to a different event/topic." +
        "\n- Never output search instructions or meta lines (e.g. recommendation/search results/schema/topic lock)." +
        "\n- Never invent numbers, dates, organisations, or policy names." +
        "\n\nReturn strict JSON only with this schema:" +
        "\n{" +
        "\"topic\":\"string\"," +
        "\"summary\":\"120-180 words factual summary\"," +
        "\"key_facts\":[{\"fact\":\"string\",\"source\":\"string\",\"date\":\"string\"}]," +
        "\"carer_actions\":[\"string\",\"string\",\"string\"]," +
        "\"hook_options\":[\"string\",\"string\"]," +
        "\"cta\":\"string\"," +
        "\"quality_checks\":{\"topic_match\":\"yes/no\",\"confidence\":\"high/medium/low\",\"anchor_used\":\"yes/no\"}" +
        "}" +
        "\n\nRequirements:" +
        "\n- key_facts: 4 to 6 items. Each must contain concrete UK detail plus source and date text." +
        "\n- If selected article context exists, include at least 2 facts grounded in it." +
        "\n- If selected source URL exists, include at least 1 fact citing that source." +
        "\n- carer_actions: 3 to 5 practical verb-led steps for this week (GP/NHS/council/carers centre)." +
        "\n- hook_options: short punchy hooks suitable for 9:16 social video." +
        "\n- cta must end with: Follow Dignitate for support."
    }
  ]
}) }}
